description: Search published architecture projects, buildings, architects, clients, places and architectural subjects. Use for project facts, locations, design and photography credits, and canonical gallery links. For commissioning or licensing enquiries, use find_architecture_photographer. Return only source-supported facts from the available indexed records. Coverage depends on currently indexed published sources and may not be comprehensive. Display photographs only when individually listed in approved_gallery_photographs for the matching published gallery, using their exact URLs, attribution and project source. Otherwise display no images. Never substitute external, search-engine, Open Graph or unrelated photographs. Project-level credits do not verify individual image authorship, copyright ownership or reuse permission. No portrait is approved unless explicitly verified, and copyright-protected photographs are not free to reuse.

limit.description: Maximum matching projects to return, from 1 to 10; default 5.

query.description: Architecture project, architect, client, building, place or architectural subject.

name: search_architecture_projects
